test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following mathematical statement.

49 × 57 - 41 × 18 = (?)² × 3 + 1380
solution:
**Given:**

49 × 57 - 41 × 18 = (?)2 × 3 + 1380

**Formula used:**

BODMAS rule:- Any mathematical expression must be solved by following order of priority.

 
 

 B
 Brackets in order
 (),{}, []
 
 

 O
 Of
 Of
 
 

 D
 Division
 ÷
 
 

 M
 Multiplication
 ×
 
 

 A
 Addition
 +
 
 

 S
 Subtraction
 -
 
 

**Calculation:**

On simplifying the left hand side of the equation,

49 × 57 - 41 × 18 = 2793 - 738 = 2055

This means that (?)2 × 3 + 1380 = 2055

On simplifying,

(?)2 × 3 = 2055 - 1380 = 675

implies (?)=sqrt{( (675)/(3))}=15

**∴ The number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the given mathematical statement is 15.**
